lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows are visible across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical white bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like pattern, most prominent in the region immediately posterior to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a high-intensity highlight on the upper edge and a lower-intensity shadow on the lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: An irregular, high-luminance white patch is visible on the posterior section of the flank, suggesting an area of physical trauma or skin depigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras (Echeneidae) are visible as elongated, dark and light striped silhouettes attached to the ventral region near the pectoral fin.
